4.title:
**Table 4. Worst-image gain from proportional allocation as a function of the budget.** VisDrone2019-DET
validation, `N = 548`. `S = B·N` is the total budget. Of the 17 swept budgets, the twelve with `B ≤ 70` are spendable (`spend/S = 1.00000`); this table lists ten of them plus `B = 100` and `B = 300`, where the budget can no longer be spent in full. `util` is the label-side utilisation from Table 1. Gains are in points; each Δ column lists seeds 42, 43, 44, and `Δ micro` is on the same allocation as the gain.
rows: | `B` | `util` | spend / `S` | Δ worst o2m | Δ worst o2o | Δ micro o2m | Δ micro o2o |

5.title: **Table 5. Structural audit of the budget sweep, on all three seeds and both heads.** The measured gain itself is in Table 4; this table reports when the comparison is well-posed. `identical vectors` marks budgets at which the uniform and proportional quota vectors are equal entry by entry, so the comparison is an identity rather than a measurement. `worst image at cap` marks budgets at which the same image is the worst under both allocations. `degenerate` marks budgets at which some image's quota falls to one box, so its recall is decided by whether the single top prediction is correct.
rows: | `B` | identical vectors | worst image at cap (uniform / prop.) | degenerate |
